case.title: Seven identical answers with only the 8th different does not fire

submissions.open_text: The hand pump handle broke last month and repairs took two weeks
Prices from the handcart sellers doubled during the dry season

case.why: This probes an off-by-one at the end of the array. A loop that compares only indices 0..6, or that only checks the first 7 answers, would see all 4s and fire. The correct rule must include the 8th answer, and 5 differs from 4, so it stays silent. Quiet checks: duration 1380 s is at least 720 s. Only one other submission falls on the same day. The texts share no content words. There is no voice note. Both times are daytime. One contributor uses the device. There are only 2 submissions. Both points are inside Nyalenda.
